notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Changes and modifications
・We made it possible to warp to the second round when the conditions are met.
※How to do it?
From the start of the 1st stage, head to the middle boss without killing any Rola.
[previewyoutube=e5VekHtH5xk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

・Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Changes and modifications
・Fixed bullet speed, bullet size, and placement of some enemies.
・The HP and attack patterns of some bosses have been changed.
・Some weapons can now fire continuously when the shot button is held down.
・The player's movement speed and bullet speed have been increased.
・Fixed the expression of the background.
・Fixed the expression of enemy is defeated.
